translations.web: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
translations.bsb: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
translations.kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
translations.asv: In thy name do they rejoice all the day; And in thy righteousness are they exalted.
